messages.subject: 轉換民國年變成Date
parts:
convROCYear = function(ROC_year) { # 106/10/01 -> Date
    v = strsplit(ROC_year,"/")[[1]]
    dd = paste0(as.character(as.numeric(v[1])+1911),'-',v[2],'-',v[3])
    return(as.Date(dd))
}                                         
t=c('106/05/02','106/05/3','106/5/4')
convROCYear(t)

希望能傳回
c('2017-05-02','2017-05-03','2017-05-04')
結果只傳回
'2017-05-02'

messages.subject: Re: 轉換民國年變成Date
parts:
Hi Danile,

1. strsplit(ROC_year,"/")[[1]] 之結果僅取出第1個元素, 所以結果只傳回'2017-05-02'

2. strsplit 之結果為 list, 因此可考慮使用 lapply, 取出 list 固定位置元素, 可使用 "[["


# title: date convert
# date: 2017.5.25

convROCYear <- function(ROC_year) { # 106/10/01 -> Date
  v <- strsplit(ROC_year,"/")
  years <- as.numeric(lapply(v, "[[", 1)) + 1911
  months <- lapply(v, "[[", 2)
  days <- lapply(v, "[[", 3)
  dd = paste0(years, "-", months, "-", days)
  return(as.Date(dd))
}                                         
t <- c('106/05/02','106/05/3','106/5/4')
convROCYear(t)
# end
